datasets.name: room_mix
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, room_type, count(*) AS listings,
       round(100 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY city_name), 1) AS pct_of_city
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_listings
GROUP BY city_name, room_type

datasets.name: availability
queryLines:
SELECT city_name,
       CASE WHEN availability_365 = 0 THEN '1) 0 days'
            WHEN availability_365 <= 90 THEN '2) 1-90'
            WHEN availability_365 <= 180 THEN '3) 91-180'
            WHEN availability_365 <= 270 THEN '4) 181-270'
            WHEN availability_365 < 365 THEN '5) 271-364'
            ELSE '6) all 365' END AS free_days_next_365,
       count(*) AS listings
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_listings
WHERE availability_365 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: top_neighbourhoods
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, neighbourhood, median_price_short_stay, short_stay_listings_with_price
FROM (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY median_price_short_stay DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_neighbourhood_stats
  WHERE short_stay_listings_with_price >= 30
)
WHERE rn <= 15

datasets.name: price_by_size
datasets.displayName: Entire homes, short stays: price by guests
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, accommodates, median(price) AS median_price, count(*) AS listings
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_listings
WHERE room_type = 'Entire home/apt' AND stay_type = 'short' AND price IS NOT NULL AND accommodates <= 8
GROUP BY city_name, accommodates
HAVING count(*) >= 20

datasets.name: price_by_room_stay
datasets.displayName: Price by room type and stay type
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, concat(room_type, ', ', stay_type) AS segment, median(price) AS median_price, count(*) AS listings
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_listings
WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND room_type IN ('Entire home/apt', 'Private room')
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) >= 20

datasets.name: model_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT model_run, scope, n_listings, baseline_mae, model_mae, pct_better_than_baseline, model_median_abs_error
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_model_metrics
WHERE is_evaluation
ORDER BY model_run, city_role

datasets.name: model_points
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_run, room_type, actual_price, predicted_price
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_model_errors
WHERE is_evaluation

datasets.name: error_by_room
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_run, room_type, count(*) AS listings,
       round(avg(abs_error), 2) AS model_mae, round(avg(baseline_abs_error), 2) AS baseline_mae
FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_model_errors
WHERE is_evaluation
GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: error_by_neighbourhood
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_run, neighbourhood, listings, model_mae, mean_error
FROM (
  SELECT city_name, model_run, neighbourhood, count(*) AS listings,
         round(avg(abs_error), 2) AS model_mae, round(avg(error), 2) AS mean_error,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name, model_run ORDER BY avg(abs_error) DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_model_errors
  WHERE is_evaluation
  GROUP BY city_name, model_run, neighbourhood
  HAVING count(*) >= 20
)
WHERE rn <= 15

datasets.name: worst_listings
queryLines:
SELECT city_name, model_run, pricing, name, neighbourhood, room_type, accommodates,
       actual_price, predicted_price, error, listing_url
FROM (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY city_name, model_run, pricing ORDER BY abs_error DESC) AS rn
  FROM workspace.airbnb.gold_model_errors
  WHERE is_evaluation
)
WHERE rn <= 15
ORDER BY city_name, pricing, abs(error) DESC
